QUOTE: "They are typed against `ServerDataOperatorBase`, so they can call `this.handleRecords` and `this.batchRecords` like the local handlers." and "`BaseDataOperator.batchRecords` ... is the single place a standard handler writes to the database."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says mixins are typed against ServerDataOperatorBase (extending BaseDataOperator), so they call the inherited batchRecords, which is the shared write path.
